name: USB Data & Power Cable
fullName: High-Speed USB Data Transmission & Power Supply Cable
tagline: Connects microcontroller boards to computers for programming, serial debugging, and 5V power
description: High-quality shielded USB data and power cable. Features dual power lines (VBUS & GND) and twisted pair differential data lines (D+ & D-) supporting full-speed UART serial programming and high-current power delivery without voltage drops.

specs.connectors: Type-A to Type-B (Arduino UNO), Micro-USB, or Type-C
specs.shielding: Braided aluminum foil shielding against EMI interference

wiringNote: Ensure you are using a 4-wire data cable (not a 2-wire charge-only cable) when flashing code or opening serial monitors.
codeSnippet: // Plug into PC USB Port and select matching COM port in Arduino IDE
commonMistakes: Using a charge-only cable that lacks D+ and D- wires (board powers on but COM port is missing in Device Manager)
